BiblicalUsage: Chadath means new, and it appears once, in the order for rebuilding the temple: three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber, paid for out of the king's house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe new timber for an old house is the whole story of the return — the same God, the same temple, and fresh wood to build it with.
